gates.title: Supply-chain security
gates.evidence: lockfile=true, Dependabot=true, CodeQL=true, SBOM=true; npm audit must run locally.

gates.title: Open-source clean-clone test
gates.evidence: Checklist exists; must be executed on a clean machine.

gates.title: Contributor security boundary
gates.evidence: SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md exist; maintainers must confirm private disclosure path and test-credential guidance.

gates.title: Repository governance
gates.evidence: Repository governance files exist; branch protection, PR requirement, force-push policy, secret scanning and push protection require GitHub verification.

gates.title: License and third-party asset audit
gates.evidence: Audit document exists; actual redistribution rights must be completed before public release.

gates.title: Legal/public-site baseline
gates.evidence: Legal-text references detected; production URLs and applicability require review.

gates.title: Release artifact reproducibility
gates.evidence: Release manifest generation exists; real Git SHA/deployment ID/migration state must be captured from the release environment.

gates.title: Feature inventory certification
gates.evidence: Feature inventory document exists; production-verified statuses must be maintained.
